Multi-Layer Depth Illusion (2.5D Parallax Stacking) Instead of a single flat background image, the hero section splits the illustration into **three distinct depth planes** stacked absolutely on top of each other inside an oversized boundary: ``` [ Top Layer: hero-top.png ] -> Foreground accents / atmospheric fog / overlays [ Mid Layer: hero-mid.png ] -> Subject (character / bot / mid-distance objects) [ Bottom Layer: hero-bot.jpg ] -> Far background (distant horizon / sky / stars) ``` ```html
``` --- ### 2. How the Scroll Animation Works When you scroll the page: 1. **Oversized Container Canvas (`--home-hero-artwork-height`)**: - The visible hero section has a height of `max(80dvh, 600px)`. - The artwork container inside is larger: `max(80dvh, 800px)`. - This height difference provides **vertical travel buffer (bleed)** so that when layers move upwards or downwards at different rates, no transparent or clipped edges are revealed. 2. **Differential Transform Velocities**: - As you scroll down (content moves up): - **Far Background (`hero-bot`)**: Moves at a low coefficient (e.g., `translate3d(0, -scrollY * 0.15px, 0)`). It feels distant and deep. - **Subject / Midground (`hero-mid`)**: Moves at a moderate coefficient (e.g., `translate3d(0, -scrollY * 0.35px, 0)`). - **Content & Typography**: Scrolls at normal 1:1 speed (`1.0x`), floating over the scenery. - Using `will-change: transform` and `translate3d(0, Y, 0)` offloads layer rendering to the GPU for smooth 60/120 FPS performance. --- ### 3. Lighting, Vignettes & Seamless Fog Fade Two crucial overlay masks sit directly above the picture layers: 1. **Text Contrast Vignette (Center Radial Mask)**: ```css background: radial-gradient( ellipse 48% 52% at center, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32) 0%, transparent 70% ); ``` *Purpose:* Places a soft, darkened halo behind the white hero heading text, ensuring crisp legibility without darkening the entire artwork. 2. **Bottom Capability Gradient (Section Fog Fade)**: ```css background: linear-gradient( to bottom, rgb(18 29 44 / 0) 0%, rgb(18 29 44) 100% ); ``` *Purpose:* Seamlessly fades the bottom of the hero scene into the exact solid background color of the next section (`#121d2c`), completely eliminating hard borders. --- ### 4. The Core Architecture: Tailwind v4 + OKLCH CSS Variable Tokens The styling relies on **Tailwind CSS v4** layered with modern CSS features: - **`@layer theme` & `@layer properties`**: Defines root CSS custom properties for semantic design tokens. - **OKLCH Color Space**: Uses perceptual color matching (e.g. `oklch(58.5% .233 277.117)` for primary indigo, neutral tones, and dark surfaces). - **Semantic Theme Variables**: ```css :root { --surface-base: #0f172a; /* Main page background */ --surface-sunken: #080d1a; /* Inset panels / commit rows */ --surface-floating: #1e293b; /* Cards & dropdowns */ --border-subtle: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); /* 1px hairline divider */ --text-default: #f8fafc; --text-muted: #94a3b8; } ``` --- ### 2. Key Techniques Connecting HTML with CSS #### A. Dynamic CSS Variable Injection via Inline Styles Instead of hardcoding fixed pixel heights or creating dozens of single-use CSS utility classes, the HTML injects CSS custom properties directly into the element style attribute, and utility classes read them: ```html

They achieve this using a parent wrapper and a pseudo-element: ```css .floating-control-frame { position: relative; padding: 1px; /* Creates the 1px border gap */ background-color: var(--floating-control-frame-color); /* Outer border gradient or subtle line */ border-radius: var(--radius-lg); z-index: 0; } .floating-control-frame:before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 1px; /* Pulls inner card inside the 1px boundary */ border-radius: calc(var(--radius-lg) - 1px); background-color: var(--surface-floating); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); z-index: -1; } ``` *Result:* Eliminates border-box subpixel jitter and creates a smooth border highlight that reacts to hover and focus states cleanly. --- #### C. # Comprehensive Plan: ExploreGit Redesign (Entire.io Design System)

## Goal Description
Redesign the **ExploreGit** user interface to adopt the aesthetic, design language, and interactions inspired by **Entire.io**. This includes adopting Entire's curated dark theme color palette, the multi-layered 2.5D parallax hero background with smooth scroll translations, the signature `.floating-control-frame` 1px border system, consistent button hierarchies, icon treatments, and section fog-fade transitions.

---

## Key Design Principles & Tokens

1. **Color Palette & Dark Theme (OKLCH & CSS Variables)**:
   - **Base Page Background (`--surface-base`)**: Deep tech navy/slate (`#0e1726` / `oklch(18% 0.03 260)`).
   - **Sunken Elements (`--surface-sunken`)**: `#090e1a` for table headers, inactive rows, code blocks.
   - **Floating Panels (`--surface-floating`)**: `#152033` for cards, dialogs, dropdowns.
   - **Hairline Dividers (`--border-subtle`)**: `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)` / `border-subtle`.
   - **Accent Color (`--color-accent`)**: Entire Indigo `oklch(58.5% .233 277.117)` / `#6366f1`.
   - **Primary Typography (`--text-default`)**: Pure high-contrast white `#f8fafc`.
   - **Secondary Typography (`--text-muted`)**: Subtle tech slate `#94a3b8`.

2. **Hero Multi-Layer Parallax Architecture**:
   - **Artwork Canvas**: Stacks 3 depth planes (Background Sky / Stars, Midground Floating Elements / Grid, Foreground Atmosphere).
   - **Boundary Oversize**: Boundary height `max(80dvh, 800px)` inside an `80dvh` section for bleed margin.
   - **Transform Velocities**: Hardware-accelerated `translate3d(0, scrollY * factor, 0)` with `will-change: transform`.
   - **Lighting Vignettes**: Central radial mask for text legibility + bottom gradient fade into `--surface-base`.

3. **Signature UI Elements (`.floating-control-frame`)**:
   - 1px outer frame + `inset: 1px` inner surface with micro drop-shadows.
   - Solid White Primary Button: `bg-white text-[#333] hover:bg-neutral-100 rounded-lg shadow-sm`.
   - Secondary / Ghost Buttons: `text-white/80 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white rounded-lg`.
   - Input search frames with inset icon alignment and zoom-safe padding.

---

## Proposed Step-by-Step Implementation

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Step 1: Theme & CSS Tokens] --> B[Step 2: Floating Frame & Button Component Utilities]
    B --> C[Step 3: Header & Navigation Restyling]
    C --> D[Step 4: Hero Component Parallax Re-architecture]
    D --> E[Step 5: Card & Feature Grid Restyling]
    E --> F[Step 6: Dashboard & Search Experience Polish]
    F --> G[Step 7: Verification & Responsiveness Testing]
```

---

### Step 1: Base Design Tokens & Global CSS (`src/styles/index.css` & `tailwind.config.js`)
- Update CSS variables with Entire's exact tokens:
  - `--surface-base`, `--surface-sunken`, `--surface-floating`, `--surface-hover`.
  - `--border-subtle`, `--border-default`.
  - `--text-default`, `--text-muted`, `--text-disabled`.
- Configure `.floating-control-frame` utility and double-border styling pseudo-elements.
- Add smooth scroll easing and hardware-accelerated transform helper classes.

### Step 2: Buttons, Pills & Icon Styling
- Define 3 clear button tiers:
  1. **Primary**: High-contrast white button with `#333` text, rounded-lg, 1px subtle ring, hover: `bg-neutral-100`.
  2. **Floating Action / Control**: Wrapped in `.floating-control-frame`, interactive hover/active states.
  3. **Nav / Ghost Link**: `text-white/80 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 h-8 px-2.5 rounded-lg`.
- Unify Lucide icon colors to `text-muted` (or `opacity-80`) with transition to `text-default` on hover.

### Step 3: Navigation Header (`src/components/layouts/Header.jsx`)
- Restyle the navigation bar to match Entire's transparent/floating glass topbar:
  - Max container width: `max-w-320` with subtle border divider.
  - Text-shadow on header text: `[text-shadow:0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.35)]`.
  - Clean pill links with `data-[state=active]` highlight styles.
  - Quick action CTA button on the top right.

### Step 4: Hero Section with Multi-Layer Parallax (`src/components/layouts/Hero.jsx`)
- Rebuild Hero layout with 3-plane stacked background illustration / canvas layers:
  - Far background layer (slow scroll translation).
  - Midground grid / telemetry layer (moderate scroll translation).
  - Foreground atmospheric lighting layer.
- Add central radial spotlight (`radial-gradient(ellipse 48% 52% at center, rgba(0,0,0,0.35), transparent 70%)`).
- Add bottom fog gradient fade (`linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--surface-base))`).
- Add a lightweight `requestAnimationFrame` scroll listener to drive differential `translate3d` translations.
- Incorporate the revolving rotating word headline ticker ("Every developer [repo | signal | stack | framework] discovered").

### Step 5: Repositories & Feature Showcase Cards
- Re-architect repository cards (`RepoCard.jsx`, `DashboardPreview.jsx`, `FeatureGrid.jsx`):
  - Inset headers with `bg-sunken` and mono-spaced commit hashes / delta stats (`+280 / -20` style badges).
  - Floating control search bar with keyboard-friendly focus rings.
  - Interactive hover row highlights (`hover:bg-hover` transition).

### Step 6: Multi-Device Polish & Responsive Boundaries
- Ensure boundary containers use `min-[1280px]:border-x border-subtle mx-auto max-w-320`.
- Verify mobile touch gestures and backdrop blur fallbacks.

---

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Hero Artwork Layers**: Entire.io uses custom bot/cyber illustration layers (`hero-bot`, `hero-mid`, `hero-top`). For **ExploreGit**, we can generate high-resolution developer/Git constellation visual layers or use SVG mesh/code grid layers that fit your exact branding.

---

## Verification Plan

### Automated Checks
- `npm run build` to ensure all JSX and Tailwind classes compile with 0 lint/type errors.

### Manual Visual Verification
1. **Parallax Performance**: Scroll up and down at various speeds to verify 60fps jitter-free motion.
2. **Text Readability**: Ensure white text is crisp across all background planes due to the radial vignette.
3. **Button & Hover Feedback**: Verify hover states on buttons, search filters, and repository rows.
4. **Mobile Responsiveness**: Test on mobile / tablet viewport widths to ensure the parallax artwork scales correctly.

# Comprehensive Plan: ExploreGit Redesign (Entire.io Design System)

## Goal Description
Redesign the **ExploreGit** website to strictly match the authentic visual design, styling rules, typography hierarchy, and interactive mechanics of **Entire.io**. 

No AI guesswork or generic colors will be used. Every color, border, padding, hover effect, button variant, icon color, and parallax coefficient will strictly follow the exact values extracted from Entire.io's design system.

---

## 1. Strict Design Specifications from Entire.io

### A. Base Color Tokens (Dark Mode)
```css
--neutral-0:    #070707;
--neutral-50:   #111111;
--neutral-100:  #161616;
--neutral-150:  #1c1c1c;
--neutral-200:  #222222;
--neutral-250:  #292929;
--neutral-300:  #333333;
--neutral-400:  #4e4e4e;
--neutral-500:  #707070;
--neutral-600:  #949494;
--neutral-700:  #b9b9b9;
--neutral-800:  #d9d9d9;
--neutral-850:  #e7e7e7;
--neutral-900:  #f3f3f3;
--neutral-950:  #fbfbfb;
--neutral-1000: #ffffff;

/* Surfaces */
--surface-base:     var(--neutral-100); /* #161616 */
--surface-sunken:   var(--neutral-50);  /* #111111 */
--surface-raised:   var(--neutral-150); /* #1c1c1c */
--surface-floating: var(--neutral-200); /* #222222 */
--surface-hover:    #ffffff0f;
--surface-active:   #ffffff1f;
--surface-selected: #ffffff14;

/* Typography & Icons */
--text-default:  var(--neutral-900); /* #f3f3f3 */
--text-muted:    var(--neutral-700); /* #b9b9b9 */
--text-disabled: var(--neutral-500); /* #707070 */
--icon-default:  var(--text-muted);  /* #b9b9b9 (opacity: 0.8) */
--accent:        oklch(67.3% .182 276.935); /* Entire Indigo / accent-orange */
--focus:         var(--accent);

/* Borders & Dividers */
--border-default: #ffffff1a;
--border-subtle:  #ffffff14;
```

---

### B. Button Hierarchies & Hover States
1. **Primary Button (Solid White CTA)**:
   - Background: `bg-white text-[#333] hover:bg-neutral-100 active:bg-neutral-200`
   - Shadow: `shadow-[0_0_0_1px_rgb(0_0_0/0.06),0_1px_2px_-1px_rgb(0_0_0/0.06),0_2px_4px_rgb(0_0_0/0.04)]`
   - Radius: `rounded-lg`, padding: `px-4 py-2.5` (or `h-8 px-3 text-sm font-normal`)
   - Text shadow: `[text-shadow:none]`
2. **Interactive Controls (`.floating-control-frame`)**:
   - Double-border technique: outer wrapper with 1px border gap, `:before` pseudo-element with `inset: 1px`, `bg-(--surface-floating)` and subtle shadow.
   - Hover: `hover:before:bg-floating-hover`
   - Active: `active:before:bg-floating-active`
3. **Ghost / Navigation Links**:
   - `text-white/80 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 active:bg-white/15 h-8 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-colors`
4. **Announcement / Pill Button**:
   - Background: `rgb(246 246 246 / 0.1)`, box-shadow: `inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06)`
   - Hover: `hover:bg-white/15`

---

### C. Hero Section Multi-Layer Parallax Architecture
Following the exact logic from Entire's `HomePage-tfU4RKYZ.js`:
- **Dimensions**:
  - Hero Section: `--site-section-height: max(80dvh, 600px)` with `overflow-hidden`
  - Hero Artwork Boundary: `--home-hero-artwork-height: max(80dvh, 800px)` (provides vertical bleed margin)
- **Layer Stacking**:
  - **Bottom Layer (`hero-bot`)**: `translate3d(0, ${r * 0.35}px, 0)` with `will-change: transform`
  - **Middle Layer (`hero-mid`)**: `translate3d(0, ${r * 0.25}px, 0)` with `will-change: transform`
  - **Top Layer (`hero-top`)**: Stationary `translate3d(0, 0, 0)`
  - *where `r = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, -top))` calculated from scroll position and disabled if `prefers-reduced-motion` is active*.
- **Vignettes & Fog Fade**:
  - **Center Radial Mask**: `radial-gradient(ellipse 48% 52% at center, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32) 0%, transparent 70%)` positioned at `bottom: calc(max(80dvh, 600px) - 464px)`
  - **Bottom Fog Fade**: `linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(22 22 22 / 0) 0%, rgb(22 22 22) 100%)` (height: `232px`, fades directly into `--surface-base`)

---

### D. Section Layout & Boundaries
- Outer section container: `border-b border-subtle bg-base`
- Centered grid container: `mx-auto w-full max-w-320 border-subtle min-[1280px]:border-x bg-base`
- Category Label: `text-site-label font-mono text-accent uppercase`
- Section Heading: `text-site-title font-headline text-default`
- Section Subtitle: `text-site-body-sm mt-3 font-sans text-muted`

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Base CSS Tokens & Root Variables
**File**: `src/styles/index.css`
- Replace existing custom palette with Entire's exact `@layer theme`, `@layer base`, `@layer components`, and `@layer utilities`.
- Configure `--neutral-0` through `--neutral-1000`, `--surface-base`, `--surface-sunken`, `--surface-floating`, `--border-subtle`, `--text-default`, `--text-muted`, and `--icon-default`.
- Add `.floating-control-frame`, `.floating-control-frame:before`, `.list-hover-transition`, and layout utility classes.

### Step 2: Global Header & Top Navigation
**File**: `src/components/layouts/Header.jsx`
- Wrap navigation inside `max-w-320 mx-auto px-4 md:grid md:grid-cols-[1fr_auto_1fr] bg-transparent text-white [text-shadow:0_1px_2px_rgb(0_0_0/0.35)]`.
- Style nav links: `text-white/80 hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white rounded-lg h-8 px-2.5`.
- Style top-right CTA button: `bg-white text-[#333] hover:bg-neutral-100 active:bg-neutral-200 rounded-lg h-8 px-3 shadow-sm`.
- Update icons to `text-muted hover:text-default` with Lucide icons.

### Step 3: Parallax Hero Component Architecture
**File**: `src/components/layouts/Hero.jsx`
- Rebuild Hero container with `--site-section-height: max(80dvh, 600px)`.
- Implement `#home-hero-boundary` with the 3 layered visual planes (`hero-bot`, `hero-mid`, `hero-top`).
- Implement the exact scroll listener with `r * 0.35` (bottom) and `r * 0.25` (mid) transforms and `prefers-reduced-motion` check.
- Add the center radial readability vignette and bottom linear fog gradient.
- Implement the announcement pill (`Meet Marvin! Mostly harmless...` style converted to ExploreGit announcement).
- Implement the Rotating Word headline ticker ("Every open-source [repository | momentum signal | AI agent | framework] discovered in your feed").
- Style the Primary CTA button (`bg-white text-[#333] hover:bg-neutral-100`).
- Implement the bottom 5-column capability navigation row (`grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 sm:gap-6 text-white`) with muted icons (`opacity-80 hover:opacity-100`).

### Step 4: Repository Showcase & Feature Cards
**Files**: `src/components/features/DashboardPreview.jsx`, `src/components/features/RepoCard/RepoCard.jsx`, `src/components/features/FeatureGrid.jsx`
- Update card containers to use `showcase-window-chrome rounded-lg border border-subtle bg-base`.
- Implement sunken table headers (`bg-sunken px-4 h-12 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-default`).
- Implement mono-spaced commit/stat hash badges (`font-mono text-xs text-muted`) and additions/deletions chips (`text-[#497d00] +280 / text-[#c10007] -20`).
- Update interactive search bar to use `.floating-control-frame` with `pl-9` search icon.

### Step 5: Footer & Section Dividers
**File**: `src/components/layouts/Footer.jsx`
- Adopt `border-t border-subtle bg-base` container with `max-w-320 min-[1280px]:border-x`.
- Text color: `text-muted` with `hover:text-default`.

---

## 3. Verification Plan

### Automated Verification
- Run `npm run build` to confirm zero CSS syntax errors and clean bundle compilation.

### Manual Visual Verification
1. **Color Contrast & Tone**: Inspect the page in dark mode to ensure all surfaces strictly use `#161616` (base), `#111111` (sunken), `#222222` (floating), and `#fafafa14` (borders).
2. **Parallax Motion**: Scroll up and down on the homepage to ensure the 3 hero layers translate smoothly without layout shifts or edge clipping.
3. **Buttons & Hover**: Confirm solid white button shows `#333` text, darkens to `neutral-100` on hover, and nav links highlight with `white/10`.
4. **Icons**: Verify all icons render in `var(--text-muted)` and transition to `var(--text-default)` on hover.
